_about: Slope of the demo farm, computed once offline because the elevation API cannot be called from the browser (no CORS header). Elevations are a 3x3 grid at 1 arc-second (~30 m) spacing around the farm, rows north to south, columns west to east. Slope uses the Horn (1981) 3x3 method.
dataset: SRTM GL1 30 m, via the OpenTopoData public API (srtm30m)
comment: At 3 arc-second (~90 m) spacing the same method gives 1.0 %. A 30 m grid smooths short, steep hillsides, so the farmer can override this value with the slider.
